news.headline: Niger's military regime 'gradually regaining control' from mutinous soldiers
news.summary: Niger's military regime said Saturday it was "gradually regaining control" after mutineers held soldiers hostage at a military base next to the capital's airport. Sustained gunfire and explosions were reported across several areas of Niamey, including the airport and near the presidential palace.
